reader_summary.headline: Jon Glidden is the CIO of Delta Air Lines, where he oversees the company's $16 billion pension fund.
reader_summary.overview: Jon Glidden is the CIO of Delta Air Lines, where he oversees the company's $16 billion pension fund. Jon joined Delta in 2011, when the plan had $7.5 billion in assets, a $13 billion underfunded liability. Despite funded status that threatened the solvency of the company thirteen years ago.
